# Virgil Digital

> Websites and Google Business Profile setup for small businesses in Bristol and the South West UK. Fixed prices, one person doing the work, direct contact. Free 15-minute audit.

## Pages

- [Home](https://virgildigital.co.uk/): what Virgil Digital does and who it is for
- [Services and pricing](https://virgildigital.co.uk/services/): packages and fixed prices
- [About](https://virgildigital.co.uk/about/): Virgil Pais, DMI Certified Digital Marketing Diploma, based in Bristol
- [Contact](https://virgildigital.co.uk/contact/): enquiry form and free audit booking
- [Work](https://virgildigital.co.uk/work/): selected client websites and products

## Work

- [Alterations by Nicole](https://alterationsbynicole.com): tailoring studio in Emersons Green, Bristol
- [Mealwright](https://mealwright.co.uk): meal-planning app website
- [Marvel Desserts](https://marveldesserts.co.uk): first website for a Bristol dessert business; currently in maintenance while updates are made
- [StaySafe Guide](https://staysafeguide.com): online safety publication built and maintained by Virgil
